reproduction_target: Development and application of a Moraxella catarrhalis core-genome MLST (cgMLST) scheme (1,319 core genes) and a LIN code barcode classification, then whole-genome population-structure analysis of ~1,913 genomes: assembly + QC of DCHS and public reads, chewBBACA scheme construction, PubMLST/BIGSdb allele calling and cgST/LIN assignment, core-gene alignment and recombination-corrected ML phylogeny, minimum-spanning-tree / clustering-resolution (silhouette, ARI) analyses, ANI, pangenome openness (Heaps' law) and accumulation curves, functional (EggNOG/COG/KEGG) classification, and virulence-gene characterisation (uspA1/uspA2/uspA2H motif typing, bro/mcb detection, LOS/16S typing).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the Materials and Methods prose. bioRxiv JATS 'source.xml' endpoint served the wrong article (a caching collision returning 10.1101/2025.05.24.655935); Methods/Data/Code text was therefore extracted from the v1.full HTML instead, cross-checked against the biorxiv API abstract. Named GitHub repo (brueggemann-lab/pgl_cgmlst_2024) read at landing/README + file-tree prose level only (stage-1); no workflow source read line-by-line. Wet-lab isolate collection / DNA extraction / WGS captured as a single W-layer step (not counted in S).

steps.label: Wet-lab: DCHS isolate collection (137 children), DNA extraction (Maxwell 16 Buccal Swab LEV kit; Qubit dsDNA HS quantification), and whole-genome sequencing (Illumina HiSeq X Ten, Wellcome Sanger Institute). Not computationally reproducible.

DCHS genome assembly via Sanger-internal pipeline: VelvetOptimiser v2.2.5 + Velvet v1.2, scaffolding with SSPACE (unversioned), gap-filling with GapFiller (unversioned); best-N50 draft selected. Described as an 'internal pipeline' with no public code.
Assembly of public short reads: VelvetOptimiser v2.2.6 or SPAdes v3.15.3, k-mer sizes 21-133 bp.
Assembly QC (genome size, N50, contig count, GC): QUAST v5.3.0. Numeric acceptance thresholds not stated in prose.
Species confirmation via rMLST species tool implemented in PubMLST (53 ribosomal loci; 100% support required). Hosted web service, no local version.
Sequence-type (ST) assignment using the 8-locus M. catarrhalis MLST scheme (Enterobase / PubMLST). Hosted web service, no version pin.

cgMLST scheme development with chewBBACA v3.3.1 (CreateSchema, AlleleCall, RemoveGenes, UniprotFinder, ExtractCgMLST, JoinProfiles; later PrepExternalSchema, SchemaEvaluator, AlleleCallEvaluator), default parameters; core = genes in >=95% of genomes.
Paralog filtering / uspA locus localisation via blastn v2.13.0 (BLAST+); >=80% identity and >=100 bp overlap removed as putative paralogs.

Allele assignment / cgST + LIN code implementation in PubMLST via BIGSdb 'sequence tagging' (90% min identity, 90% min alignment, blastn word size 20, 5% stop-codon length tolerance); LIN thresholds 1290/832/281/85/20/8/4/2/1/0. Hosted BIGSdb, unversioned.
Core-gene concatenated-sequence alignment with MAFFT v7.525 (missing alleles as gaps).
Polymorphic-site extraction with SNP-sites v2.5.1 (total alignment 175,014 bp).
Maximum-likelihood phylogeny with IQ-TREE2 v2.2.6 (ModelFinder Plus, -m MFP+ASC ascertainment-bias correction, 1000 bootstrap replicates).
Recombination-corrected tree with ClonalFrameML v1.13; midpoint-rooted.
Tree visualisation with interactive Tree Of Life (iTOL) v7. Interactive/manual web visualisation, not scriptably reproducible from prose.
Minimum-spanning tree from cgST allelic profiles with GrapeTree (unversioned).
Functional classification of core genes with EggNOG-mapper v2.1.12 -> COG categories -> KEGG BRITE grouping.
Average nucleotide identity across all genomes with ANIclustermap v1.2 (FastANI calculation mode, default parameters; github.com/moshi4/ANIclustermap).
Pairwise allelic-mismatch and silhouette-index clustering-resolution analysis with MSTclust v0.21b, default parameters (gitlab.pasteur.fr/GIPhy/MSTclust).
Clonal-complex assignment via global eBURST (SLV level) implemented in PHYLOVIZ v2.00; ARI concordance vs rST/ST/CC.
Pangenome-openness (Heaps' law alpha) from chewBBACA presence/absence matrix using R package micropan v2.1.
Pangenome / core-genome accumulation curves with PanGP v1.0 ('totally random' sampling, 10 repeats).
ORF identification in extracted uspA intergenic regions with ORF Finder v1.8.
uspA1/uspA2/uspA2H motif detection & classification (GGG/FAAG/CTER1/CTER2) with MAST from MEME Suite v5.5.6, default parameters.

Core-gene concatenation for downstream alignment/phylogeny via repository script concat_aln.py (github.com/brueggemann-lab/pgl_cgmlst_2024, Analysis/). Script present in repo but no interpreter/dependency pinning.

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 21 of 23 computational steps; 2 steps (C1 Sanger-internal assembly pipeline, C13 interactive iTOL visualisation) fall to NI in prose because they lack public code / scriptable specification. R★ not assignable at stage1. The paper pins exact versions for a majority of named tools (chewBBACA 3.3.1, BLAST+ 2.13.0, MAFFT 7.525, SNP-sites 2.5.1, IQ-TREE2 2.2.6, ClonalFrameML 1.13, QUAST 5.3.0, SPAdes 3.15.3, EggNOG-mapper 2.1.12, ANIclustermap 1.2, MSTclust 0.21b, PHYLOVIZ 2.00, micropan 2.1, PanGP 1.0, MEME 5.5.6, ORF Finder 1.8) but with NO environment closure: the linked repo (brueggemann-lab/pgl_cgmlst_2024) carries no environment.yml, conda-lock, renv.lock, DESCRIPTION, requirements.txt or container, and several web-hosted steps (PubMLST rMLST/MLST, BIGSdb tagging, iTOL) are unversioned. capture_claim='exact_pins_partial' -> stage2_candidate=true: a stage-2 pass could examine whether the partial exact pins are executable, but the ceiling stays RI absent a lockfile/container.
headline.coverage: 23 computational steps + 1 wet-lab step assessed from the v1.full Methods prose, biorxiv-API abstract, and the GitHub repo landing/README/file-tree (prose only). Analysis data (assemblies + accessions) are hosted in PubMLST; the repo contains R figure scripts and one Python concatenation script, i.e. it covers figure/analysis-glue rather than the full assembly->scheme->phylogeny pipeline.

gaps.missing: No environment.yml / conda-lock / renv.lock / DESCRIPTION / requirements.txt / Dockerfile / container digest anywhere in the repo (file tree: Analysis/concat_aln.py, Figures/*.md R code, README.md, LICENSE, pgl.png). ~16 tools carry exact version pins but there is no closure over their dependencies, R/Python interpreter versions, or OS.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda-lock/pixi.lock or a container image (with digest) capturing the full tool stack + R/Python environment for a declared platform; add a top-level manifest mapping each Methods tool to its locked version.

gaps.where: Pipeline code coverage (assembly, chewBBACA runs, allele calling, phylogeny)
gaps.missing: The Code-availability repo is 'adapted from' a pneumococcal codebase and shared across three manuscripts; it contains R figure scripts + one concatenation script but not the assembly (Velvet/SPAdes), QC (QUAST), chewBBACA module invocations, BIGSdb tagging config, MAFFT/SNP-sites/IQ-TREE2/ClonalFrameML command sets used for this study. Much of the pipeline is described in prose only.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the actual driver scripts / command logs / config for each Methods stage (or a workflow: Snakemake/Nextflow) tied to this M. catarrhalis analysis, ideally in a M. catarrhalis-specific tagged release.

gaps.missing: Data availability points to PubMLST (assemblies + per-isolate accession numbers, Supplementary Data 1) but does not give a single consolidated SRA/ENA BioProject for the 1,447 DCHS raw-read sets; public reads are described 'as of March 2023' without a frozen accession list beyond supplementary tables.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a consolidated accession manifest (BioProject/SRA run list + PubMLST isolate IDs) as a versioned file so the exact input set is retrievable deterministically.

gaps.missing: The paper cites a floating repo (github.com/brueggemann-lab/pgl_cgmlst_2024, default branch main, last push 2025-06-05) with no tagged release or Zenodo DOI for this manuscript; the repo is explicitly reused across three papers, so HEAD does not pin the state used here.
gaps.how_to_close: Mint a tagged release + Zenodo archive DOI for the exact commit used in the M. catarrhalis analysis and cite that commit/DOI in the paper.

gaps.where: Hosted-service determinism (PubMLST rMLST/MLST, BIGSdb sequence tagging, iTOL v7, Enterobase MLST)
gaps.missing: Several steps depend on live web services (unversioned) whose allele/definition databases evolve over time; results can drift as PubMLST/Enterobase definitions are updated. No snapshot date/version of the definition databases is fixed beyond query dates.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the PubMLST/BIGSdb scheme + database versions/dates used, and where possible provide an offline/exportable copy of the definitions to allow deterministic re-tagging.
